QUOTE: The app's network client defaults to `retryLimit: 3` with exponential backoff (`app/managers/network_manager.ts:68-73`). But `createPost` in `app/client/rest/posts.ts:43-47` passes `noRetry: true`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the default retry (limit 3, exponential, in network_manager) and that createPost opts out via noRetry.
